description: Screens a token for security-provider risk flags, reported DEX liquidity, and public web or social evidence, then returns a CAUTION or ALERT verdict. Use for a broad pre-trade token screen; for a buy/sell honeypot test use `rug_honeypot_quick_check`, for admin-power analysis use `contract_security_scan`; paid 3.3 USDC via x402.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. EVM: 0x plus 40 hex chars. Solana: base58, 32-44 chars.

name: token_due_diligence

liquidityAssessment.description: DEX pool depth, volume signals, and liquidity health metrics

riskFlags.description: Specific risk indicators found during screening

socialSignals.description: Recent mentions, sentiment polarity, manipulation flags from X/Discord/web

verdict.description: Overall risk verdict: PASS (safe entry), CAUTION (elevated risk — enter only with tight risk controls), or ALERT (significant red flags — avoid)

title: Token Due Diligence
